## HAPI v0.26.0.2

Maintenance hotfix on top of official `v0.26.0` / upstream `main`.

### Fixes
- Fix React error #185 (maximum update depth) on session chat: `MessageActions` no longer selects a fresh object from `useAuiState` every render (upstream [#1380](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/issues/1380) / [#1381](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1381)).

### Carried from v0.26.0.1
- Distribution overlay, schema attachments repair, PRs #1359, #986, #955, #906, and integration fixture repairs.
